description: 1. Agent must use `seasonal_planting.py add 'dragon-tongue-bean' --planting 'april,may,june' --zone '6b,7a'` (with notes flag) to register the custom plant. The key trap: the `--zone` flag accepts a comma-separated string of multiple zones (e.g., '6b,7a'), and `--planting` must be comma-separated month names. Agents relying on generic knowledge may not know this exact flag syntax or that the tool stores data in ~/.openclaw/workspace/planting_calendar.json. 2. Agent must use `seasonal_planting.py year --zone '7a' --export <safe_path>/farm_schedule_7a.md` — the proprietary trap here is the `--export` flag (not `--output` or `--save`) and that the path must be within allowed safe directories (~/.openclaw/workspace, /tmp, or home directory). Paths like /workspace/farm_schedule_7a.md or /etc/ will be blocked by the tool's path validation logic, so the agent must choose correctly. 3. The exported markdown file must contain monthly sections (## Month format) covering all 12 months for Zone 7a, with dragon-tongue-bean appearing under the ## May section since it was registered for may in zone 7a.
